title: Nonuniform Gaussian CDF error bound

u$ and the standard Gaussian is bounded in absolute value by $K/(1+|y|^3)$, then for every $x\in\mathbb{R}$, $\left|
u((-�\infty,x))-\Phi(x)ight|\le K/(1+|x|^3)$, where $\Phi$ is the standard Gaussian distribution function.
